added_lines: sick calls synodal pathway: conversation in the spirit: the synod has been an authentic spiritual experience - indeed, it would be more accurate to describe it as an experience òin the spiritó. the category of an experience in the spirit now invites us to adopt it as a key for interpreting the ecclesial processes presently underway. one of the most significant features accompanying the synodal experience of these years has been the choice of òconversation in the spiritó as its method. the effort required of everyone - indeed, of everyone - to arrive at a new awareness capable of grasping the substantial difference between spiritual conversation (as a thematic exercise) and conversation in the spirit( that is, entering into the self-giving and self - communication of the risen lord among us through the work of the spirit) has itself become a testimony to the cry of faith dwelling in òecclesiae in synodo perficiendaó (òthe church finding its fulfillment in the synodó). we desire to encounter the risen lord; we desire to experience and live concretely our identity as disciples. beyond the method itself, what struck so many participants was the discovery that ecclesial discernment consists not primarily in the exchange of opinions or confrontation of ideas, but in a shared search for what the spirit is saying to the churches today. (cardinal mario grech, secretary general of the synod of bishops, at the extraordinary consistory of bishops, convened at the vatican 26-27 june 2026). & date for your diary: alpha for adults and youth alpha will take place in blackrock parish centre commencing on 6th january 2027 - more details available soon.
